parole.testo: First attested in 1782. Borrowed from German Grenze, from a Slavic language, ultimately from Proto-Slavic *granica.

First attested around 1430. Arrived in the Hungarian language primarily via German and Slavic languages. Ultimately, from German which itself can be traced back to the Vulgar Latin buxis (“box”). Compare German Büchse, Serbo-Croatian puška, Russian пушка (puška), Romanian pușcă.
